author: Mark Atwood
text: Cross-platform confirmation (worker3, m2r9 review): the same ASan probe false-negative reproduces on Linux gcc 13.3.0 (Ubuntu 24.04), not just Apple clang — two independent codereview passes on the rpl_root_sig conversion observed UBSan-only linkage despite LICHEN_TEST_ASAN=ON, and CMakeConfigureLog.yaml shows the try-compile link step failing on undefined __asan_init. The CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS fix in test_common.cmake covers both platforms; affected surface is every host suite using lichen_test_target (9+ suites), so rpl_root_sig's fresh conversion also gains only UBSan until this lands.
